title: Support familiar Siri Remote gestures

statement.en: Support fluid, familiar Siri Remote gestures for powerful and delightful tvOS interactions.
statement.ja: powerfulでdelightfulなtvOS interactionのためfluidでfamiliarなSiri Remote gestureをsupportする。

conditions: Use gesture behavior people already know from the Siri Remote.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Designing for tvOS experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDesigning for tvOSの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
